newsitem.title: DUBAI: Yemeni president holds talks with Saudi king.
newsitem.headline: Yemeni president holds talks with Saudi king.

text.p: Yemeni President Ali Abdullah Saleh on Saturday held talks with Saudi Arabia's King Fahd on a long-standing border dispute between the two countries, the official Saudi Press Agency (SPA) said.
The two leaders, meeting in Mecca, expressed their determination to end the problem as soon as possible, the agency said.

Yemen and Saudi Arabia are exerting efforts to settle the 60-year-old border dispute, which led to several minor clashes in the potentially oil and gas-rich area before the two sides signed a memorandum of understanding in 1995 to resolve the row.
Saleh and King Fahd also discussed regional developments, SPA said.
The Yemeni leader, who made a pilgrimage to the Moslem holy city of Mecca on his visit, has left the kingdom, SPA said.
